name: site-announcement-bar
title: Announcement Bar
description: A one-line notice across the top of every page, with an optional link and a dismiss button that hides it until the page is loaded again (nothing stored, no button without JavaScript); two layouts (bar, band), colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Bar
layouts.description: A quiet full-width bar in your design's sunk ground, the text and link in ink, centred in one row; the default.

layouts.title: Band
layouts.description: A full-width band on your brand colour, the text, link, dismiss icon and focus rings in on-brand.

proof: installs alone on Next 16; two layouts (bar, band); dismissed until reloaded, nothing stored, no button without JS; 3 sample brands, light and dark, 390/768/1280 px, 2 hosts; axe clean
postMessage: See components/site-announcement-bar/README.md for the layouts, where to place it (after your header), the dismiss button, the labels (German included) and the design tokens it reads.
